question: What is the common name of the compound NaHCO₃?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baking soda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baking soda** is the common name for the compound **sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)**.
 
• It is a white crystalline powder that is commonly used in baking as a leavening agent.
 
• When baking soda reacts with acidic components in the batter, it releases carbon dioxide gas, which causes the batter to rise and become fluffy.
 
• In addition to its culinary uses, baking soda has various other applications, including as a cleaning agent, in personal hygiene products, and in fire extinguishers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium bicarbonate** is also used in medical treatments, such as for acid indigestion and heartburn, due to its ability to neutralize stomach acid.
 
• It is often found in household products like toothpaste and deodorants because of its mild abrasive and odor-neutralizing properties.
 
• In science, it is used in chemical laboratories for various experiments and as a buffering agent.
 
• It is important to store baking soda in a dry place to prevent it from reacting with moisture in the air.
